items.source:
Can be overridden to customize the behavior, for example in case of
multiple templates to be rendered into a single view.
items.translation: 可被重写以自定义行为，例如在将多个模板渲染到单个视图的情况下。

items.source: Attribute name of the RequestContext instance in the template model, available to Spring's macros — for example, for creating BindStatus objects.
items.translation: 模板模型中 `RequestContext` 实例的属性名称，可供 Spring 宏使用——例如用于创建 BindStatus 对象。

items.source: Autodetect a FreeMarkerConfig object in the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 自动检测 `ApplicationContext` 中的 `FreeMarkerConfig` 对象。

items.source: Prepare the model to use for rendering by potentially exposing a RequestContext for use in Spring FreeMarker macros and then delegating to the inherited implementation of this method.
items.translation: 通过可能暴露一个 `RequestContext` 供 Spring FreeMarker 宏使用，然后委托给继承的此方法实现来准备用于渲染的模型。

items.source: Depends on a single FreeMarkerConfig object such as FreeMarkerConfigurer being accessible in the application context. Alternatively the FreeMarker Configuration can be set directly via setConfiguration(Configuration).
items.translation: 取决于单个 `FreeMarkerConfig` 对象，例如在应用程序上下文中可访问的 `FreeMarkerConfigurer`。或者，可以直接通过 `setConfiguration(Configuration)` 设置 FreeMarker `Configuration`。

items.source: If the encoding is not explicitly set here or in the FreeMarker Configuration, FreeMarker will read template files using the platform file encoding (defined by the JVM system property file.encoding) or UTF-8 if the platform file encoding is undefined. Note, however, that FreeMarkerConfigurer sets the default encoding in the FreeMarker Configuration to "UTF-8".
items.translation: 如果此处或 FreeMarker `Configuration` 中未显式设置编码，FreeMarker 将使用平台文件编码（由 JVM 系统属性 `file.encoding` 定义）读取模板文件；如果平台文件编码未定义，则使用 UTF-8。但请注意，FreeMarkerConfigurer 会在 FreeMarker `Configuration` 中默认设置编码为 "UTF-8"。

items.source: Typically this property is not set directly. Instead a single FreeMarkerConfig is expected in the Spring application context which is used to obtain the FreeMarker configuration.
items.translation: 通常不会直接设置此属性。相反，预期在 Spring 应用程序上下文中存在一个单一的FreeMarkerConfig，用于获取 FreeMarker 配置。

items.source: Defaults to null to signal that the FreeMarker Configuration should be used to determine the encoding.
items.translation: 默认为 `null`，以指示应使用 FreeMarker `Configuration` 来确定编码。

items.source: See setEncoding(String) for details.
items.translation: 有关详细信息，请参阅setEncoding(String)。

items.source: Needed for Spring's FreeMarker default macros. Note that this is not required for templates that use HTML forms unless you wish to take advantage of the Spring helper macros.
items.translation: 需要用于 Spring 的 FreeMarker 默认宏。请注意，对于使用 HTML 表单的模板来说，并非必须安装，除非您希望利用 Spring 辅助宏。

items.source: Note: To ensure that the correct encoding is used when rendering the response as well as when the client reads the response, the following steps must be taken.
items.translation: 注意： 为确保在渲染响应以及客户端读取响应时使用正确的编码，必须执行以下步骤。

items.source: A non-null encoding will override the default encoding determined by the FreeMarker Configuration.
items.translation: 非空编码将覆盖由 FreeMarkerConfiguration 确定的默认编码。

items.source: It's recommended to specify the encoding in the FreeMarker Configuration rather than per template if all your templates share a common encoding.
items.translation: 如果所有模板都使用相同的编码，建议在 FreeMarker `Configuration` 中指定编码，而不是为每个模板单独指定。

items.source: Note that the specified or default encoding is not used for template rendering. Instead, an explicit encoding must be specified for the rendering process. See the note in the class-level documentation for details.
items.translation: 请注意，指定的或默认编码不用于模板渲染。相反，必须为渲染过程显式指定编码。有关详细信息，请参阅 类级别文档 中的说明。

items.source: The default implementation builds a SimpleHash.
items.translation: 默认实现构建一个SimpleHash。

items.source:
By default, the template specified by the "url" bean property will be retrieved,
and the returned mono will subscribe on the
bounded elastic scheduler as template
lookups can be blocking operations.
items.translation: 默认情况下，将检索由"url"bean 属性指定的模板，并且返回的 mono 将在有界弹性调度器上订阅，因为模板查找可能是阻塞操作。

items.source: Set whether to expose a RequestContext for use by Spring's macro library, under the name "springMacroRequestContext".
items.translation: 设置是否暴露一个 `RequestContext` 供 Spring 的宏库使用，名称为 "springMacroRequestContext"。
